decision_basis: Constructed discipline control, not a documented historical Ackman rejection or a short recommendation.

Large manufacturing investment and negative adjusted FCF weaken the fit with self-funding long investments; low earnings multiple/dividend does not fix reinvestment economics.
drivers.quote: do not need access to the capital markets to survive and thrive

drivers.driver: PC cyclicality and technological execution dominate outcomes beyond ordinary operating activism; pass unless a separately justified bounded special situation can be demonstrated.

outcome_note: No subsequent company or stock outcome is used to validate this constructed PASS. It tests business predictability, reinvestment and capital dependence, not a universal prohibition on semiconductor investments.
